source: Uptime Institute, Global Data Center Survey 2024 (industry average, n=526); Meta, 2025 Sustainability Report Environmental Data Index (fleet-wide self-reported PUE)
methodology: No public source publishes a true PUE percentile/quartile table, so this row is an anchor construction, not a measured distribution. p50 = Uptime Institute's stated 2024 global INDUSTRY AVERAGE PUE (1.56, n=526 operators) used as an approximate typical value, not a literal survey median. p25 = Meta's self-reported fleet-wide 2024 PUE (1.08), the best of three named hyperscalers checked directly (Google TTM 2025=1.09, Microsoft FY25=1.17); this almost certainly outperforms the true 25th percentile of the broader surveyed population, so treat it as a conservative best-in-class reference point, not a measured quartile. No p75/p90 data is publicly available.
